description: Short, pictorial and animated early-learning adventures for children ages 4-8.

records.title: ABC Adventures
records.subject: alphabet and phonics
records.description: Meet letters through colorful pictures, sounds, and animated letter play.

records.title: Read My First Words
records.subject: early reading
records.description: Blend sounds and match simple words to bright picture clues.

records.title: Write Letters & Numbers
records.subject: handwriting
records.description: Follow animated stroke trails and practice drawing letters and numbers.

records.title: Tell Time with Ticky the Clock
records.subject: analog clock and time
records.description: Move around a friendly analog clock and learn hours, half-hours, and daily routines.

records.title: Meet the Animal Friends
records.subject: animals and nature
records.description: Identify animals by picture, sound, movement, and home.

records.title: What Is That? Everyday Objects
records.subject: object identification
records.description: Name and sort familiar cars, toys, dolls, buildings, school supplies, and home objects.

records.title: Connect the Dots & Discover
records.subject: number order and drawing
records.description: Follow numbered dots to reveal playful pictures and practice number order.

records.title: Shapes & Colors Parade
records.subject: shapes, colors, and geometry
records.description: Spot circles, squares, triangles, and colors in an animated picture parade.
